newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Astra banking unit to offer shares.
newsitem.headline: Astra banking unit to offer shares.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Bank Universal, a unit of the Astra Group conglomerate, said on Tuesday it planned to offer shares to the public in mid-September.
"The offer period is planned for September 15-17, with applications lodged for listings on the Jakarta and Surabaya stock exchanges," Bank Universal said in a statement.
It said brokerage firm PT SBC Warburg Indonesia would act as the lead managing underwriter for the offering.
As of December 31, 1996, the bank's total assets were 3.5 trillion rupiah, making it the 12th largest private bank in Indonesia, the statement said.
The statement did not give further details.
